references.context: Use a spinner or the center star rollover to move the Golden Arrow when its shot is unsafe.
references.label: Center star rollover
references.description: The center rollover sits on the gold arrow graphic and advances the Golden Arrow.

references.label: Arrow-advance spinners
references.description: Either upper spinner advances the Golden Arrow one number.

references.label: Number standups
references.description: Four numbered standups with hazardous direct rebounds.

references.label: Number lanes
references.description: Four numbered lanes whose exits can reach slingshots or outlanes.
